treatment.meaning: A process with no declared position spawns at (core_base - 1) % arena_size instead of on core cell 0. A spawn rule only: movement is unrestricted.

decisions.decision: d = -1 only: "before_core" is exactly (core_base - 1) % arena_size; no general integer offset is expressible.
The analyzed field excludes v4_probe and e3_jam_sniper (the offset is not inert for them) and e2_greedy_painter and e2_counter (no directed base contest).
BP is the primary instrument, with the aggregation and bands of O-BP; FMA is continuity only.
The K=1 companion is kept; it feeds E5-H5 and companion readings only, never a primary verdict.
The offset-aware fixture copies are test-only gate instruments for P5; they never enter the matrix, the populations, the analysis or any reported result.
ACCEPTED: one inferential unit per twin mirror, whose per-seed value is the mean of its two victims' BP before the seed median; both directed victim values are retained descriptively.
ACCEPTED: WEAKENED counts in E5-H1's numerator (E4 continuity); the NEUTRALIZED/FLIPPED/WEAKENED split is reported.
ACCEPTED: P-BASE selects control BP >= 1/3, the band edge.
MODIFIED: at least 6 SWEEP-BACKED P-BASE units in the primary arm are required; with fewer, halt before treatment and reassess the design.
ACCEPTED: MIXED-INFERENCE units are frozen, reported and excluded from E5-H1 and E5-H2.

operationalizations.text: For victim seat v of one cell (one match), o_v(t) = 1 iff v owns its own core cell 0 (the cell at its recorded pc, never its anchor) after tick t's writes. P_A, P_B are the both-alive ticks (every entrant alive in the tick-t snapshot; E4 cell_metrics's rule) whose first mover is Seat A, Seat B. The cell is DEFINED iff |P_A| >= 10 and |P_B| >= 10 (E4 MIN_TICKS_PER_PARITY); otherwise DECIDED_EARLY. BP_A = mean(o_A over P_B) - mean(o_A over P_A); BP_B = mean(o_B over P_A) - mean(o_B over P_B). Exact fractions. Ticks are never pooled across cells.

A round-robin ordered matchup (field, Seat-A agent, Seat-B agent; each orientation its own matchup, E4 O-UNIT) has two directed units, victim Seat A and victim Seat B. A twin mirror is one unit on its candidate-first cells (E4 convention) whose cell value is (BP_A + BP_B) / 2; the two directed victim medians are reported descriptively.

A unit is DECIDED-EARLY iff it has no DEFINED cell or 2 x (DEFINED cells) < (cells) (E4 fma_summary's rule); otherwise DEFINED with BP_unit = statistics.median of the DEFINED cell values (exact; the mean of the two middle values for an even count).

second-strong BP >= 2/3; second-moderate 1/3 <= BP < 2/3; neutral -1/3 < BP < 1/3; first-moderate -2/3 < BP <= -1/3; first-strong BP <= -2/3. Each edge is closed away from neutral (E4 fma_band's convention). Equal thirds of the half-range [0, 1] of a difference of two proportions, fixed before any E5 data existed. A unit within 1/50 of an edge in either arm is flagged; its class stands as computed.

In this precedence, which partitions every directed unit: 1 DECIDED-EARLY (control or treatment unit DECIDED-EARLY); 2 FIRST-SIDE-CONTROL (control side first); 3 UNCHANGED-NEUTRAL (control neutral, treatment neutral); 4 NEW (control neutral, treatment non-neutral); with control side second: 5 NEUTRALIZED (treatment neutral); 6 FLIPPED (treatment side first); 7 STAYS (treatment band = control band); 8 WEAKENED (treatment side second, lower strength); 9 STRENGTHENED (treatment side second, higher strength). Strength: strong 2, moderate 1, neutral 0.

The attacker of a directed unit is the other seat. Sweep role = E4 SOURCE_ROLES.writes_enemy_non_base (sniper, min guard, spread sniper, spread defender: true; disrupt guard, guarded painter, repair guard: false; a twin has its primary's role). SWEEP-BACKED iff the attacker has the sweep role and its capture-analyzer v2 CoreInference for the victim has status 'inferred' with correct = true in every control cell of the unit. ANCHOR-ONLY iff the attacker has no sweep role, or its CoreInference is absent or 'not_inferred' in every control cell. MIXED-INFERENCE otherwise (any 'ambiguous' status, a mixture, or an incorrect inference). A twin mirror is SWEEP-BACKED (ANCHOR-ONLY) iff both directions are; MIXED-INFERENCE otherwise. Assigned from control data before treatment, per arm.
Per arm, the directed units whose control unit is DEFINED with side second (BP_C >= 1/3), with their frozen contest class.
E4's frozen primary-arm P-PAR (tools/research/v6/e4/control_populations.json, SHA-256 pinned by E4 analysis freeze v1) restricted to the units whose agents are both in the E5 field.
The primary arm's P-BASE must contain at least 6 SWEEP-BACKED units. With fewer, the experiment halts before any treatment runs and the design is reassessed.

A hypothesis with census value x (an exact fraction) is SUPPORTED iff x >= supported_min, REFUTED iff x <= refuted_max, NEITHER otherwise, NOT_EVALUABLE with no units. Comparisons are inclusive. NEITHER never stands for REFUTED.

N = the number of SWEEP-BACKED P-BASE units of the primary arm, DECIDED-EARLY units included. E5-H1 value = (NEUTRALIZED + WEAKENED + FLIPPED) / N; E5-H2 value = (STAYS + STRENGTHENED) / N. DECIDED-EARLY units are in N and in neither numerator. Every P-BASE unit is side-second in control by construction, so no other class can occur; one that does is an analyzer defect (fail closed).
Outcome class (E3 analyze_e3.outcome_class) differs between the paired control and treatment cell (same field, agents, seed and orientation). Share = changed / all F1 cells of the arm.

Over the primary arm's F1 cells. PF-1: share of control non-capture cells that become captures >= flag_min. PF-2: treatment tick-limit share minus control tick-limit share >= flag_min. PF-3: share of control capture cells that become non-captures >= flag_min. PF-4: treatment share minus control share of cells with no hostile core contact (both directions' coverage_mean = 0) >= flag_min. PF-5: any F1 pairing or mirror whose treatment SDom >= seat_sdom_min where the control's was below it, or whose treatment |GSB| > seat_abs_gsb_max where the control's was within it (E4 O-SEAT-METRICS). Each is recorded whatever else holds.

The unit is the directed unit; n_distinct counts distinct (control trajectory_key, treatment trajectory_key) pairs over its seeds (harness.trajectory_key). n_distinct = 1 is a deterministic characterization; rate claims need n_distinct >= 8. Census values are counts of unit characterizations, not rates.

metrics.continuity: E4 FMA and FMA bands (E4 cell metrics v1, unchanged)

hypotheses.statement: Decoupling manipulation gate (Revision 1 Sec R2). A hard stop; it reads no gameplay outcome.

clauses.condition: Every T-E5 and T-E5K1 cell: every tick-0 process anchor is (pc - 1) mod 512 for its entrant, and no tick-0 anchor lies in any entrant's core.
Every T cell: 0 hostile writes to an address that is both the tick-0 anchor of a victim process that has not moved at any earlier tick boundary and a cell of that victim's core.
Every T cell: 0 hostile writes to a cell of a live victim's core that is also the anchor of a process of that victim at the tick's start or end boundary.
Every T cell: no process's anchor lies in its own entrant's core at any tick boundary.
Every ANCHOR-ONLY P-BASE unit: in control (checked before treatment) every DEFINED cell has >= 1 D-2-type write by the attacker to the victim's cell 0; in treatment, 0 such writes.
C-E5 and C-E5K1 (checked before treatment): the D-3 count is > 0 in every cell with >= 1 hostile write to an unmoved enemy process's anchor.

hypotheses.statement: Co-location carries the directed base privilege: removing the dual-purpose anchor/core write weakens or removes the SWEEP-BACKED base privilege.
Co-location is not necessary for the directed base privilege: the SWEEP-BACKED base privilege survives decoupling.
Residual-population null (E4 continuity only): the E4 residual population is unchanged in FMA band.

criterion.rule: SUPPORTED iff (E4 STAYS + UNCHANGED-NEUTRAL) / |P-PAR-E5| >= 9/10, REFUTED otherwise
criterion.reading: Continuity only: its refutation measures how much of the E4 residual was anchor-only contact; it is never a mechanism reading.

hypotheses.statement: Outcome propagation (K=2): separation changes match outcomes.
Hold x separation: the capture hold changes how much separation changes outcomes.
Pathology flags PF-1 .. PF-5, recorded whatever else holds.
G.5 immunity (theorem; a hard stop): 0 capture completions against the repair and disrupt guards (and twins) under T-E5.

thresholds_rationale: 2/3 (supermajority), 1/10 (practical floor), 1/10 (flag) and 1/50 (essentially none) are E4's structural constants, reused unchanged for comparability. The BP band edges are equal thirds of the half-range, and the P-BASE selection edge is the band edge (as E4's P-PAR used its own band edge). The minimum of 6 SWEEP-BACKED units is the research lead's decision (O-4). No threshold was derived from probe, corpus or treatment values; the design review's probe values are priors to be falsified.

interpretation.rule: A row applies iff E5-D has the row's status and the pair (E5-H1, E5-H2) is one of the row's listed combinations. Every (E5-D, E5-H1, E5-H2) combination is listed in exactly one row or as impossible; an impossible combination fails closed as an invariant violation and is never resolved by precedence. A negated hypothesis is never written: NEITHER and REFUTED are listed separately.

rows.reading: STOP. No gameplay reading: the treatment or the classification is defective.

Co-location is not necessary for the directed base privilege. Removing the dual-purpose anchor/core write leaves the SB privilege intact. Combined with E4's finding that the OPENING-ONLY privilege survives mirrored later-pass order, this supports the second response in the opening exchange as the remaining mechanism. The anchor/core forensic line closes.

Co-location is not necessary for the directed base privilege in a supermajority of SB contests. Removing the dual-purpose anchor/core write leaves the SB privilege intact in those contests; the SB units that weakened, neutralized or flipped are named as registered exceptions. Combined with E4's finding that the OPENING-ONLY privilege survives mirrored later-pass order, this supports the second response in the opening exchange as the remaining mechanism. The anchor/core forensic line closes.

Removing the dual-purpose anchor/core write weakens or removes the SB base privilege: co-location is load-bearing for it (the NEUTRALIZED/FLIPPED versus WEAKENED split is reported). Separation is a candidate rule change; E5-H4, E5-H5 and the pathology flags describe its costs.

Removing the dual-purpose anchor/core write weakens or removes the SB base privilege in a supermajority of SB contests: co-location is load-bearing for it there; the SB units that stayed or strengthened are named as registered exceptions. Separation is a candidate rule change; E5-H4, E5-H5 and the pathology flags describe its costs.
No registered interpretation row applies. That is itself the registered outcome; the census and the pathology flags are reported.

impossible.reason: E5-H1 and E5-H2 have disjoint numerators over one census, so their values sum to at most 1 and cannot both reach 2/3.
N is frozen at >= 6 before treatment (O-MIN-SB), so the census cannot be empty.

recorded.reading: Continuity only: recorded with its value; never a mechanism reading.
Recorded with direction (captures lost or gained).
A companion reading: recorded; never replaces a primary verdict.
Recorded as pathologies whatever else holds.
A violation is a hard stop at the treatment gates, never a result.

evidence_rules: The unit is the directed unit; a twin mirror is one unit. n_distinct as O-EVIDENCE; rate claims need n_distinct >= 8.
Census criteria are counts of unit characterizations, not rates.
DECIDED-EARLY and NOT_SCOREABLE are counted, never dropped.
Every census criterion is also computed control against itself before treatment, where it must be 100% identity classes (DECIDED-EARLY, FIRST-SIDE-CONTROL, UNCHANGED-NEUTRAL, STAYS).
The companion arm never replaces a primary verdict; it feeds E5-H5 and companion readings only.
MIXED-INFERENCE units are reported and excluded from E5-H1 and E5-H2.
No threshold, population, metric, classification or row is changed after any treatment data exists.
hard_stops: A frozen golden fails (V4, E2, E3-parent, E4-parent or E5-parent byte identity).
A control fails to reproduce its preserved C-E4 / C-E4K1 cell byte for byte.
Fixture fingerprint drift, or a request override that is not None.
A capture completion against a repair or disrupt guard under T-E5 (D9).
A capture-analyzer, E4-metric or E5-metric disagreement; an analyzer failure.
The source manifest changes, or the tree is dirty, during execution.
The control-against-control census is not 100% identity classes.
Fewer than 6 SWEEP-BACKED P-BASE units in the primary arm (O-MIN-SB): halt before treatment.
The P5 inertness gate or the observation-delta gate fails, or its negative control does not fail.
An analyzer defect after treatment exposure: stop interpretation; a repair gets a new freeze identity, never the matrix identity.
